deleteWorkflowDescription: The "{{name}}" workflow definition will be permanently deleted. Past run records remain in the journal. This cannot be undone.
codeDefinedTitle: Code-defined — lives in a source file, cannot be edited from the UI
defLoadFailed: Could not load '{{name}}' — not opening the editor, so an empty draft cannot overwrite it. {{error}}
invalidJsonForm: Invalid JSON — form disabled. Fix the text or load a preset.
cancelledNote: Cancelled (watching stopped — the run on the server may finish in the background)
stepModeTitle: Stop after every step; on Continue, previous steps replay from the journal
dryRunTitle: No real agent is called (stub response), nothing is written to the journal — validate the flow at no cost
continueTitle: Run the next step: {{stepId}} (previous steps replay)
retryTitle: Retry with the same runId (completed steps replay, the failing step runs again)
forkSuccess: Fork: {{count}} step outputs copied — branch running
nameImmutableNote: Name cannot be changed (editing an existing workflow).
promptTemplateHelp: Leave empty to pass the previous step's output as-is. Use {{input}} for the initial input and {{prev}} for the previous output.
whatIfForkTitle: The output of the first {{count}} steps is copied; '{{label}}' and everything after it runs again
notRunYetNote: Not run yet — run the workflow to see output.
inboxEmptyDescription: Nothing needs your approval right now. Runs that pause for human input show up here.
inboxCancelDialogDescription: "{{runId}}" will be durably canceled — it stops at its next step on any worker and refuses to resume again. This cannot be undone.
inboxCancelNoop: "{{runId}}" was already completed — nothing to cancel
inboxNoWaitIdNote: This run has no recorded waitId — the registry can't tell which suspend point to target. Resuming may not reach the right step.
inboxWorkflowKnownTitle: The server recorded exactly which workflow this run belongs to.
inboxWorkflowGuessedTitle: No workflow name was recorded for this run — this was inferred from the run ID's naming pattern. Double-check before resuming.
inboxSelectWorkflowError: Select the workflow this run belongs to
runningGuardTitle: A workflow run is in progress — leaving now would cancel it
discardChangesDescription: This workflow draft has unsaved changes. Canceling now discards them.
